if score >= 60 then
    print("Pass")
else
    print("Try again")
endif
p: Use > instead of >= and explain the effect at the boundary 60.
k.a:
Original output: Pass.
Changes: 59: Try again. At 60, > gives Try again while >= gives Pass.
